verdict.rationale: Otter's homepage claims deal details, notes, and next steps are automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM, and its pricing lists Salesforce and HubSpot integrations, marked with an asterisk. However, the enterprise blog describes the CRM integration mainly as querying the CRM from Otter AI Chat, which is read-direction. Nothing documents how notes are matched to the right contact or deal records. missing for 10: documentation of auto-matching to contact/deal records, Attio support, detail on what fields or objects get written to Salesforce/HubSpot, clarity on the asterisked plan limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
